Fleshy Curse.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
Fleshy Curse.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6: ▪ On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. ▪ On a 2‑4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. ▪ On a 5‑6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.

Infernal Vigour.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).

Wreathed in Warpflame.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.
Wreathed in Warpflame.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]. Chosen for Glory.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Chosen for Glory.target: One **DAMNED** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Chosen for Glory.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Chosen for Glory.lore: Within the massed ranks of a heretic cult, only a few are marked for greatness.

Crazed Focus.target: One **DAMNED** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Crazed Focus.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.
Crazed Focus.lore: Even in the grip of frothing madness, these heretics are murderous in the extreme.

Infernal Sacrifice.target: One **DAMNED** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Infernal Sacrifice.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (in addition to any suffered for failing the resulting Leadership test), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of those weapons by 1 as well.
Infernal Sacrifice.lore: Those in thrall to the Dark Gods will gladly sacrifice their lives to draw the eye of their darkling patrons.

Reckless Haste.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Reckless Haste.lore: Consumed by a desire to spill blood, these fanatical heretics hurl themselves towards the foe.

Selfless Demise.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Selfless Demise.target: One **DAMNED** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Selfless Demise.effect: Until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.
Selfless Demise.lore: The zealous followers of the Dark Gods are devoted to the last. As death comes they strike a desperate final blow in hope of reward.

Delayed Mutations.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit (excluding Damned units) from your army.
Delayed Mutations.effect: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation (see Experimental Augmentations). Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.

Diabolic Regeneration.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit (excluding Damned units) from your army.
Diabolic Regeneration.effect: One destroyed model (excluding Character models) is returned to your unit. If your unit is a Battleline unit, D3 destroyed models (excluding Character models) are returned to your unit instead.

Masters Are Watching.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Masters Are Watching.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Masters Are Watching.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a Damned unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Monstrous Visages.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Monstrous Visages.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Monstrous Visages.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Specimens for the Spider.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Specimens for the Spider.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a Character unit, you can re‑roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy Character models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test. If the enemy Warlord was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle‑shock test instead.

Soul-Tally Offerings.target: One **SOUL FORGE** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

Coils of Deception.when: Your Movement phase, just after a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army Falls Back.
Coils of Deception.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Coils of Deception.lore: Some Heretic Astartes are masters of deceit, often feigning retreat only to open fire from close range.

From All Sides.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army.
From All Sides.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit for each other **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that made a Charge move this phase (to a maximum of +3).
From All Sides.lore: When the assault comes, it does so swiftly and without warning.

Pick Them Off.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Pick Them Off.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Pick Them Off.lore: The Heretic Astartes are pitiless reavers, targeting weak points in the enemy line with ruthless efficiency.

Depthless Cruelty.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Depthless Cruelty.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Depthless Cruelty.lore: Terror troops such as these inflict agonies upon their victims with malicious relish, targeting the weakened and wounded without pity.

Pitiless Hunters.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Pitiless Hunters.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Pitiless Hunters.lore: These predatory warriors sense weakness as the hydrashark smells blood, sating their bloodlust upon the fearful and wounded.

Relentless Terror.when: Your Movement phase, just after a **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army Falls Back.
Relentless Terror.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Relentless Terror.lore: These warriors strike in screaming waves, each charge as brutal as the last.

Brutal Attrition.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Brutal Attrition.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Brutal Attrition.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack is allocated to your unit, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6 (to a maximum of six D6 per attacking unit): for each 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
Brutal Attrition.lore: These implacable soldiers weather the enemy’s fury before striking back in kind, to devastating effect.

Persistent Assailants.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more attacks this phase and has not been selected to fight this phase.
Persistent Assailants.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit is Below Half-strength you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Persistent Assailants.lore: These iron-willed warriors refuse to retreat, even in the face of overwhelming odds. Mounting losses serve only to drive them forward.

Pitiless Cannonade.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Pitiless Cannonade.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Pitiless Cannonade.lore: These warriors focus their ire upon a wounded foe, combining fire to fell their target in a cavalcade of destructive force.

Point-blank Destruction.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Point-blank Destruction.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit’s ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons) have the **[PISTOL]** ability.
Point-blank Destruction.lore: Even in the press of combat, the Heretic Astartes bring heavy weapons to bear, shattering fortifications and obliterating enemy infantry.

Siegecraft.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Siegecraft.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army.
Siegecraft.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
Siegecraft.lore: Veterans of countless grinding sieges, these Heretic Astartes repel and pin down wave after wave of foes with rapid boltgun fire and accurate artillery.

Steadfast Determination.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Steadfast Determination.target: One **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit from your army (excluding **DAMNED** units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Steadfast Determination.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
Steadfast Determination.lore: These warriors possess endless endurance and are capable of weathering untold hardships in order to destroy their foes.
